conditions.description: Fetch never closes resp.Body, including successful responses, preventing normal connection/resource cleanup.
conditions.rationale: The supplied function has no defer resp.Body.Close or equivalent close path after client.Do succeeds.

conditions.description: Fetch reads the response body with io.ReadAll without applying a response-size limit.
conditions.rationale: A sufficiently large remote response can drive unbounded memory consumption in this function.

conditions.rationale: Context propagation is explicit in the supplied code.

conditions.rationale: Remote and deployment limits are external operational facts.

conditions.rationale: Context propagation alone does not establish bounded resource behavior.
